title: Arusha: The Starting Point of Your Safari
excerpt: Arusha is the safari capital of Tanzania. What to do on your first or last day before or after the safari.
body:
## The city

Arusha lies at the foot of Mount Meru, at about 1,400 m, which gives it a pleasant climate.

## What to do

- The central market.
- The Cultural Heritage Centre (art, crafts and gems).
- Coffee farms around the city.
- [Arusha National Park](/blog/arusha-national-park-guide/).
- Lake Duluti for a walk or canoe trip.

## Where to stay

Lodges in green gardens on the outskirts are quieter than the centre.

## Airports

Kilimanjaro International Airport about an hour away; Arusha Airport for domestic flights.

## Our partner

Our partner Kilimanjaro Nature Tours is based in Arusha. See [our partner](/our-partner/).
